strategy.offer: Medical technology materials, equipment, digital manufacturing solutions, and support services for dental work, hearing-system fitting, and device care.
strategy.customers: Dental practices and laboratories, hearing-care professionals and laboratories, large device manufacturers, and other specialist medical-technology users.
strategy.why_we_win: It expects to win through continuously improved, integrated systems delivering precise, durable, biocompatible results, efficient workflows, and dependable support across customers’ processes.

strategy.direction: It is expanding digital, automated production, increasing capacity, improving sustainability, maintaining fast turnaround, and securing regulatory certification to keep launching innovative products.
